# Analyse Mattress GSC Performance

Run `npm run seo:mattress:inventory`, `npm run seo:mattress:validate-inventory`, and direct GSC fetches for latest, previous, and discovery windows. Use only `sc-domain:findyouridealmattress.com`; record property, fetch time, ranges, row counts, dimensions, and limitations. If access is missing, state the service-account email if available, exact property, Search Console location, Full user permission, and rerun command. Never expose credentials or fall back to another product.

Audit every inventory page, including zero-data pages. Segment GBR and USA separately and retain other countries as context. Compare non-overlapping complete 28-day periods and the 90-day discovery view. Attribute query clusters to the page that best serves the query, flag only credible cannibalisation, and include commercial hub, guide, comparison, and review coverage.

Use GSC alongside current route, product, sitemap, internal-link, and SERP evidence. Identify declines, growth, emerging demand, content gaps, discovery defects, and product-evidence gaps. Produce five distinct ranked opportunities where evidence permits, not several monitoring tasks. Select one meaningful current action; waiting for data cannot be the final action while verification, research, or unaffected work remains.
